15: - **Difficulty Mechanics**:
16:   - **Memory Game**:
17:     - Convert from a stopwatch counting up to a **countdown timer** (time limit).
18:     - Limit starts at **60 seconds** at Level 1, decreasing by 1 second per level, capping at a minimum of **20 seconds** (`Math.max(20, 60 - (state.level - 1))`).
19:     - If the timer hits 0, the player loses the game and gets no rewards.
20:   - **Sort Game**:
21:     - Limit starts at **15 seconds** at Level 8, decreasing by 1 second every 3 levels, capping at a minimum of **8 seconds** (`Math.max(8, 15 - Math.floor((state.level - 8) / 3))`).
22:     - The penalty for incorrect category choices scales:
23:       - Level 8-14: Deduct **1 second**.
24:       - Level 15-29: Deduct **2 seconds**.
25:       - Level 30+: Deduct **3 seconds**.
